name: My views
description: A console-style New Tab page of your own: a monospaced > prompt that starts an agent chat, every chat as a list, and a way into Recently Closed.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats (title, state, folder, agent) to list them.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click its row.
scopes.actions:run: Start a chat from the prompt, open a chat with no workspace, and open Recently Closed.
